190	  rootHref: string
191	}
192	
193	function buildTrail(
194	  path: string,
195	  tab: string | null,
196	  dynamicLabels: Record<string, string>,
197	  { rootLabel, rootHref }: BuildTrailOptions,
198	): Crumb[] {
199	  const crumbs: Crumb[] = [{ label: rootLabel, href: rootHref }]
200	
201	  const segments = path.split('/').filter(Boolean)
202	  // Skip the root segment ONLY when path actually starts with rootHref
203	  // (e.g., "/admin/studios" with rootHref="/admin" strips the leading "admin").
204	  // For virtual roots like "/dashboard" above "/inbox", the path does NOT
205	  // contain "dashboard" as a segment — we keep all segments and accumulate
206	  // the built path from empty, not from rootHref.
207	  const rootPrefix = rootHref === '/' ? '' : rootHref
208	  const pathStartsWithRoot = rootPrefix !== '' && (path === rootPrefix || path.startsWith(rootPrefix + '/'))
209	  const rootSegments = rootPrefix.split('/').filter(Boolean)
210	  const relativeSegments = pathStartsWithRoot ? segments.slice(rootSegments.length) : segments
211	
212	  let built = pathStartsWithRoot ? rootPrefix : ''
213	  relativeSegments.forEach((seg, i) => {
214	    built += '/' + seg
215	    const isLast = i === relativeSegments.length - 1
216	    const overrideLabel = dynamicLabels[built]
217	    const label =
218	      overrideLabel ??
219	      SEGMENT_LABELS[seg] ??
220	      // Fallback: title-case the segment (swap - → space)
221	      seg.replace(/-/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase())
222	
223	    const isCurrent = isLast && !isTabCrumbPending(path, tab)
224	    const crumb: Crumb = isCurrent ? { label } : { label, href: built }
225	    crumbs.push(crumb)
226	  })
227	
228	  // Append tab crumb if current path is a tab host and tab is set
229	  const tabLabels = TAB_HOSTS[path]
230	  if (tabLabels && tab && tabLabels[tab]) {
231	    crumbs.push({ label: tabLabels[tab] })
232	  }
233	
234	  return crumbs
235	}
236	
237	function isTabCrumbPending(path: string, tab: string | null): boolean {
238	  if (!tab) return false
239	  const tabLabels = TAB_HOSTS[path]
240	  return !!tabLabels && tab in tabLabels
241	}
